Models & Pricing

All prices below are per million tokens. A token is the smallest unit that a model uses to represent natural language text; it can be a word, a number, or a punctuation mark. You are billed based on the total number of input and output tokens.

Billing

The charge equals token consumption multiplied by the model unit price, and is deducted from your top-up balance or gift balance. When both balances exist, the gift balance is deducted first.

Prices are subject to change. DeepSeek reserves the right to modify prices. Please top up based on your actual usage and check this page regularly for the latest prices.
